headline: Researchers dismantled Windows 11's toughest defenses in software alone as supply-chain malware colonized Android cars and pro-Ukraine hackers burrowed into Russian technology firms.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep climbing upstream in the software supply chain, seeding malware in DoFun car head-unit updaters, harvesting still-live AWS keys, and probing CI/CD pipelines rather than finished applications.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Exposed AWS Keys and CI/CD Supply Chain

emerging_trends.text: Credential theft now outruns the reset, as the iAuthFlow V2 kit quietly registers attacker-controlled passkeys that outlive password changes and session revocation.
The Russia-Ukraine conflict keeps bleeding into cyberspace, with pro-Ukraine group Black Spark claiming a month inside Russian network-monitoring firm Microolap and its EtherSensor platform.

topics.title: Windows 11 Security Defenses Bypassed
topics.latest_developments: Researchers at the University of Birmingham and Durham University showed how to knock down some of Windows 11's strongest protections through software alone, without opening or modifying the target machine, once an attacker already holds privileged access.
topics.summary: The technique defeats hardware-backed Windows 11 defenses after an intruder gains privileged access, undercutting protections many enterprises lean on; administrators should tighten privilege escalation controls and monitor for local compromise.

sources.title: Week in review: Records allegedly stolen from Azure tenants, Medusa ransomware hits 500+ orgs

topics.title: Android Car Head Unit Malware
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky, which found the threat in June 2026, detailed a supply-chain campaign that plants malware in Android vehicle head-unit firmware built by DoFun and spreads through the units' built-in update apps to run a multi-stage downloader.
topics.summary: The malware enlists compromised car infotainment systems into a proxy botnet and drives ad fraud; owners and installers of DoFun-firmware head units should treat built-in updaters as an infection vector.

sources.title: Hackers infect Android car head units with proxy botnet malware
Android Car Malware Spreads Through Built-In Updaters for Ad Fraud, Proxy Botnet

topics.title: Pro-Ukraine Hackers Breach Russian Firms
topics.latest_developments: Russian network-monitoring firm Microolap confirmed a cyberattack after the pro-Ukraine group Black Spark claimed it spent more than a month inside the company's systems, including its EtherSensor traffic-analysis platform, as Ukraine paired cyber and drone strikes against a Russian ecommerce giant.
topics.summary: Pro-Ukraine hacktivists are penetrating Russian technology and commerce companies and lingering for weeks; Russian operators of EtherSensor and similar network tooling face intrusion and data theft.

sources.title: Russian network monitoring firm confirms cyberattack claimed by pro-Ukraine hackers
Your Expired Visa Card Could Be 'Zombified' to Make Contactless Payments

topics.title: Exposed AWS Keys and CI/CD Supply Chain
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer reported that more than 9,300 AWS access keys leaked publicly between August 2022 and August 2026 remain active and valid, handing full control of corporate accounts, as Unit 42 warned attackers increasingly target CI/CD pipelines and developer tools over application code.
topics.summary: Long-exposed cloud credentials still unlock corporate AWS accounts, and the software development lifecycle itself has become the target; organizations should rotate and revoke stale keys and lock down developer pipelines.

sources.title: Hundreds of leaked AWS keys give full control over corporate accounts
Connecting the Dots: Securing the Overlooked Corners of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Supply Chain

topics.title: CISA Staffing Cuts Investigation
topics.latest_developments: Lawmakers called for a formal investigation into how recent CISA staffing cuts have hit the agency and whether it has replaced the expertise it lost.
topics.summary: Congress wants to measure the operational damage from CISA workforce reductions even as cash-strapped local governments already scramble for cyber defense help.

sources.title: Lawmakers call for investigation into impact of CISA staffing cuts
Calling on Cyber Pros to Help Defend City Hall

topics.title: Passkey-Abusing Phishing Toolkit iAuthFlow V2
topics.latest_developments: Researchers detailed iAuthFlow V2, a phishing toolkit that registers an attacker-controlled passkey during account takeover so intruders keep access even after victims change passwords and revoke active sessions.
topics.summary: The kit converts passkeys into a persistence mechanism that survives standard incident response; defenders should audit and remove unrecognized registered passkeys after any suspected account compromise.

sources.title: New Phishing Toolkit Uses Passkeys to Maintain Access After Password Resets

business_politics.title: U.S.-Canada Trade War Takes Effect
business_politics.latest_developments: The 50% U.S. tariffs went live early Saturday, August 22, on about $20 billion of Canadian goods, and Prime Minister Mark Carney told Canadians that President Trump 'miscalculated' by escalating.
business_politics.summary: Negotiations between Washington and Ottawa collapsed Friday night after U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Canada walked away from agreed terms, and Carney pledged to match the levies dollar for dollar starting September 8, opening a tariff war between two G7 allies.

sources.title: U.S., Canada Spiral Toward Trade War
Mark Carney says Canada ‘at war’ with US over trade
U.S. Imposes 50% Tariffs on Some Canadian Goods After Last-Ditch Talks Fail

business.title: Kosher Market Opens on Murray Avenue
business.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette reported August 23 that a new kosher market on Murray Avenue in Squirrel Hill will stock entirely kosher goods after a monthslong dispute over the store.
business.summary: Murray's Avenue Market in Pittsburgh's Squirrel Hill neighborhood, the city's traditional Jewish commercial heart, resolved a months-long fight to reopen as a fully kosher grocery.

sources.title: Everything will be kosher in this new Squirrel Hill market after a monthslong beef

around_town.title: Kelly Draws Challenger Justin Wagner
around_town.latest_developments: TribLive reported August 23 that U.S. Representative Mike Kelly, seeking a ninth term, faces Democrat Justin Wagner in his Western Pennsylvania district.
around_town.summary: Mike Kelly, the second-longest-tenured member of Pennsylvania's congressional delegation, will defend his seat against Justin Wagner in the northwestern district anchored around Butler and Erie counties.

sources.title: Mike Kelly faces challenge from Justin Wagner in Western Pa. congressional district

around_town.title: Last First Day at Closing Schools
around_town.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette reported August 23 that thousands of Pittsburgh Public Schools students are starting their final first day of classes at buildings the district plans to shut.
around_town.summary: Pittsburgh Public Schools opened the new year at several schools slated for closure, marking the last opening day for students and staff at those buildings before the district consolidates.

sources.title: Thousands of Pittsburgh Public Schools students gear up the final first day at closing schools

around_town.title: Charter Schools' Vaccine Enforcement Gaps
around_town.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette investigation published August 23 found that weak vaccination enforcement in Pennsylvania charter schools leaves thousands of children unprotected as measles spreads.
around_town.summary: The reporting lands as Allegheny County confirmed its first measles case since 2019, showing charter schools across the state track and enforce required immunizations far less rigorously than traditional public schools.

sources.title: Vaccine enforcement gaps in Pennsylvania charter schools put thousands of children at risk

around_teams.title: Porter Contract and Ramsey Injury
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette's Steelers notes August 23 laid out the latest on cornerback Joey Porter Jr.'s contract situation and Jalen Ramsey's injury status.
around_teams.summary: The Steelers are weighing Porter's next deal as the Pittsburgh native enters a pivotal season, while veteran defensive back Jalen Ramsey's health is drawing attention heading toward the opener.

sources.title: Steelers notes: What's the latest with Joey Porter Jr. and Jalen Ramsey?

around_teams.title: Hiles Warns Against Four Quarterbacks
around_teams.latest_developments: Post-Gazette columnist Noah Hiles argued August 22 that keeping four quarterbacks in 2026 would be a mistake for the Steelers.
around_teams.summary: Hiles wrote that carrying Aaron Rodgers, Mason Rudolph, Will Howard, and Drew Allar on the roster wastes a spot the Steelers need elsewhere, and the team should trim the group before the season.

sources.title: Noah Hiles: The Steelers would be wrong to roster four quarterbacks in 2026

around_teams.title: Cherington Nears 1,000 Games
around_teams.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette analysis August 21 marked Ben Cherington approaching 1,000 games as Pirates general manager by tracing seven straight losing seasons under owner Bob Nutting.
around_teams.summary: The piece charts how Cherington's rebuild has failed to produce a winning club since he took over in 2019, framing the milestone against the franchise's long slide.

sources.title: The Pirates' Ben Cherington era is about to hit 1,000 games. Here's how 7 seasons of losing unfolded.

team_usa.title: NWSL Midseason Player Rankings
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN published its ranking of the 25 best NWSL players August 22, two-thirds through the 2026 season, weighing United States internationals Trinity Rodman and Rose Lavelle for the top spot.
team_usa.summary: The list gauges the current form of American women's national team regulars in the NWSL, the domestic league that supplies most of the U.S. roster, ahead of the next international window.

sources.title: Ranking the 25 best players in the NWSL right now: Rodman? Lavelle? Who's No. 1?

team_usa.title: Ranking USMNT's Premier League Careers
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN ranked the best Premier League careers by U.S. men's national team players August 21 as the 2026-27 English season opened with several Americans set for big minutes.
team_usa.summary: The list places Christian Pulisic, goalkeeper Brad Friedel, and Clint Dempsey among the top American performers in England's top flight, a guide for fans following USMNT stars after the summer World Cup.
